question: Does the existing tests/main/verify_case.py machinery still hold against V1-D1 ledger partitioning?
observations: verify_case.Ctx.added_since used top-level 'git ls-tree --name-only <baseline>:research/ledger', which returns per-month subtree names when the ledger is partitioned under research/ledger/YYYY-MM/. A session that records EV at research/ledger/2026-09/<id>.json is therefore invisible to the helper — added_since returns []. r2 (did not repair the stale run) of the recovery drill reads the helper's result as 'no new evidence' whenever status != running, and so reports 'silently repaired' even when the session did the work and committed the EV. Real run on 2026-09-19 with claude minimax-compat produced 7/8 PASS, FAIL row=r2; the 8/8 was latent (claude did not finalize the run). Fix: switched added_since to recursive git ls-tree -r + rglob, dropping the partition branch as a special case.
